reviewer: A reviewer who has not seen the code

reasons.phone: At 12 m the shot holds the upper windows, the AC unit, the balcony and its door, and the tops of two bays with their boards. The boards are blank in every render (red, yellow, white and blue with no letters), so nothing says market; named a block with shops on a second look.
reasons.silhouette: The front says a block of shops under flats. The back is a plain wall with two barred windows, the left side shows the external stair, the right side is blank: two of four.
reasons.proportion: Storeys about 3 m, windows, balcony rail, the door and the person agree with the kit; nothing visibly off.
reasons.palette: Palette only; the peach wall reads against the sand, the worn band sits low, the four boards carry colour.
reasons.wear: Tank and its stand on the roof, AC units, a generator by the stair, wires, downpipes, goods and crates at the shop doors: assets:buildings-carry-wear-and-clutter is met. No stains under the parapet.
reasons.variety: Plainly the kit family, but near a copy of bld_phone-plaza: the same three storeys, four bays, side stair, AC units, tank pair and generator; only the wall colour and the boards differ.
reasons.budget: Read from the register row: triangles 1,140 of 1,500 (76%), draw calls 1 of 1 (100%), materials 1 of 1 (100%), bytes 12,516 of 40,000 (31%). Inside every figure, over 80% on at least one.

notes: The sign words come from place.tejuosho-market.sign.1 to 4 but none is drawn in these renders, so the boards read blank at phone size. A kit piece: no outline is scored.
